payload.goal: Register supplier invoice from Dalheim AS in Tripletex, creating the supplier first if missing, with expense account 6340 and input VAT 25%.
success_checks: Supplier Dalheim AS with org.nr 859434118 exists in Tripletex
Supplier invoice INV-2026-2252 is registered with invoice date 2026-03-08 and due date 2026-04-07
Invoice amount is 60375 with net 48300 and input VAT 12075
Expense account 6340 is used on the posting
Bank account/reference 77600194847 is stored on supplier or invoice where supported
risk_notes: Customer company/legal entity receiving the invoice is not identified beyond 'Ditt firma'
PDF does not state supplier email, phone, contact person, or payment KID/reference
Tripletex may require a specific VAT code rather than only 25%; map to correct input VAT code for account 6340
If supplier invoice registration requires voucher series/fiscal period settings, those are not provided
ordered_steps: If not found, create supplier with name Dalheim AS, organization number 859434118, address Parkveien 36, 7010 Trondheim, bank account 77600194847
Prepare supplier invoice payload with supplier Dalheim AS, invoice number INV-2026-2252, invoice date 2026-03-08, due date 2026-04-07, currency NOK if required
Add invoice line/posting: description Programvarelisens, account 6340, net amount 48300, input VAT 25%
Set gross total 60375 and verify VAT amount 12075
Attach or reference the source PDF if attachment upload is supported
Verify the created supplier invoice and accounting posting match the PDF totals and dates

planned_endpoints.summary: Create supplier. Related supplier addresses may also be created.
Find accounts corresponding with sent data.
Add new voucher. IMPORTANT: Also creates postings. Only the gross amounts will be used. Amounts should be rounded to 2 decimals.

rules: When email is provided, ALWAYS set BOTH email AND invoiceEmail to the same value.
ALWAYS include phoneNumber if provided in the prompt — scoring checks phone.
ALWAYS include postalAddress with addressLine1, postalCode, city, country={id: 161} when address info is provided.
Use ?number=XXXX to resolve a specific account number to its ID.
Do NOT use other query params — they are not supported.
Do NOT use /ledger/accountingPeriod — it does not exist.
ALWAYS set BOTH amountGross AND amountGrossCurrency to the SAME value on every posting.
Do NOT include postings with row=0 — row 0 is system-generated and will cause a 422.

When using vatType != 0 (e.g. VAT 25%), include ONLY the debit posting with the GROSS amount (incl VAT). Tripletex auto-generates VAT split and credit posting. If this fails with a balance error, fall back to manual postings for all legs.
For supplier invoices, set supplier={"id": supplier_id} on the debit posting.
For salary/payroll vouchers, set employee={"id": employee_id} on each posting.
Always resolve account numbers via GET /ledger/account?number=XXXX first, then use account={"id": resolved_id}.
Postings with vatType={"id":0} (exempt) can include both debit and credit lines manually.
FORBIDDEN: /supplierInvoice is not available in sandbox.
Use POST /ledger/voucher with supplier reference instead. See register_supplier_invoice playbook.

payload.headline: Supplier and voucher created but 2 checks failed, likely due to vatType=0 and missing invoice linkage
what_went_wrong: First voucher POST failed (422) because only one posting was included — Tripletex requires balanced postings summing to zero.
Used vatType id=0 (no VAT) on the expense posting instead of the correct inngående MVA 25% vatType (id=1), which likely caused Check 4 to fail.

Check 6 likely failed because the voucher was not linked to a supplier invoice object (POST /supplierInvoice) — a raw ledger voucher may not satisfy invoice-specific checks like due date and invoice number linkage.
Two extra GET /ledger/account calls were needed after the first voucher failure, adding unnecessary API calls.
what_worked: Supplier Dalheim AS created successfully on first attempt with correct org number, address, and bank account.
Final voucher balanced correctly with debit 6340 + debit 2710 + credit 2400 = 0.
what_to_try_next: Use POST /supplierInvoice instead of POST /ledger/voucher to register supplier invoices — this endpoint handles due date, invoice number, and VAT linkage natively and likely satisfies the failed checks.
When using ledger/voucher, apply vatType id=1 on the expense posting (account 6340) and omit the manual 2710 VAT posting — let Tripletex auto-generate the VAT leg.
Pre-fetch all required account IDs (6340, 2710, 2400) in a single batch before attempting the voucher POST to avoid extra calls after failures.
unnecessary_calls: GET /ledger/account for account 2710 — could have been fetched upfront before first voucher attempt
GET /ledger/account for account 2400 — could have been fetched upfront before first voucher attempt
POST /ledger/voucher (first attempt) — would have been avoided if all postings were prepared correctly from the start
